doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: North Carolina A&T and its band
summary: A&T had no music degree, but he played marching and semi-classical music in the band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: How far away is Greensboro from Badin?
From my home town, 64 miles north.

Well, it was an agricultural and technical school. They didn’t have a music department. I mean, they had a music department, but they didn’t have a music degree. But I got into the band, and got to play in it, so I was all right.
What sorts of things did you play in that band, and what sorts of things were you used to playing...
Marching bands and little semi-classical tunes.
